title: Awesome Jev research papers
scope: Curated direct preprints; findings remain author-reported. No experimental reproduction implied.

papers.title: JevAgentHarness: Benchmarking, Deploying and Training Decision Models That Share Control with LLMs
papers.en: Studies fitted confidence thresholds for sharing agent control with decision models.
papers.zh: 研究通过拟合置信度阈值，让决策模型参与 agent 控制。

papers.title: System1-Arena: Which Decisions Can Be Left to System 1?
papers.en: A benchmark spanning matched requests and closed-loop tasks. Experiments have not been reproduced here.
papers.zh: 涵盖匹配请求与闭环任务的基准；本项目尚未复现其实验。

papers.title: DecisionRobust: Benchmarking Robustness for JEV Style Decision Models Across Text and Vision
papers.en: Text and vision attacks with label-validity checks and held-out evaluation models.
papers.zh: 结合标签有效性检查与留出评测模型，考察文本和视觉攻击。

papers.title: Jeva: System One Models from First Principles
papers.en: A decision-model architecture exploring null handling, option permutations, scaling, and caching. Its design is Jeva’s, not Jev’s disclosed internals.
papers.zh: 探索空答案、选项排列、规模扩展与缓存的决策架构。这是 Jeva 的设计，并非 Jev 已披露的内部实现。

papers.title: Reading Right, Acting Wrong: Diagnosing Decision Failures of System One Models in Agent Loops
papers.en: Pairs factual probes with action choices to diagnose decision failures.
papers.zh: 将事实探针与行动选择配对，诊断决策失败。

papers.title: Same Attack, Different Judge
papers.en: A controlled adversarial comparison of Jev, LLM judges, and purpose-built safety classifiers.
papers.zh: 对 Jev、LLM 评判模型与专用安全分类器进行受控对抗比较。

papers.title: Decision Models vs. LLMs as Rubric Judges
papers.en: Compares rubric judges and examines correlated errors that can limit cascade improvements.
papers.zh: 比较评分准则评判模型，考察相关错误如何限制级联系统的收益。

papers.title: General Decision Models: Benchmarking and Insights Beyond Jev
papers.en: Bilingual decision evaluation and reliability when local decisions compose into larger systems.
papers.zh: 双语决策评估，以及局部决策组合成更大系统时的可靠性。

papers.title: JEV-as-a-Judge: Accept When Confident, Escalate When Unsure
papers.en: Studies confidence-based escalation from Jev to a reasoning judge, including limits under distribution shift.
papers.zh: 研究基于置信度从 Jev 升级到推理评判模型的方法，以及分布变化下的局限。

papers.title: MetaEncoder: Exploring the Limit of Bi-Encoders for Multimodal System One Decision Making with Natural Language Interface
papers.en: Bi-encoder approach to multimodal decisions and retrieval through natural-language interfaces.
papers.zh: 通过自然语言接口实现多模态决策与检索的双编码器方法。

papers.title: Type-Safe Is Not Error-Free: Typed Decision Models Follow the Option Name, Not the Definition Bound to It
papers.en: Tests conflicts between option names and definitions despite structurally valid outputs.
papers.zh: 检验输出结构合法时，选项名称与定义之间的冲突。

papers.title: JEV versus LLMs: Accuracy, Cost and Calibration on Seven Political Science Replications
papers.en: Studies accuracy, cost, and calibration in seven political-science replication tasks.
papers.zh: 在七项政治学复现任务中考察准确率、成本与校准。

papers.title: System One Models for Agent Security Decisions
papers.en: Examines reliability, group-specific confident errors, and selective automation in security decisions.
papers.zh: 研究安全决策中的可靠性、不同群体的高置信错误与选择性自动化。

papers.title: AnyJev Technical Report
papers.en: Training-free decision readout with label-prior and option-order correction.
papers.zh: 无需训练的决策读出，修正标签先验与选项顺序偏差。

papers.title: JevSpawn: Adaptive Agentic Inference through Compositional Action Spaces
papers.en: Composes finite action fields and explores alternatives using interaction feedback.
papers.zh: 组合有限行动字段，利用交互反馈探索候选路径。

papers.title: Evaluating and Benchmarking the System One Model Jev
papers.en: An early benchmark study of Jev. Read the task selection and evaluation setup alongside its reported results.
papers.zh: Jev 的早期基准研究。阅读报告结果时，同时检查任务选择与评测设置。

papers.title: Chinese-Jev: Bringing System One Models to Chinese-Language Tasks
papers.en: A Chinese typed-decision model and proposed benchmark; domain-specific training calls for independent validation.
papers.zh: 面向中文的类型化决策模型与新基准；领域专用训练的效果仍需独立验证。

papers.title: Sys1Cal-v1: A Dataset for Probability Calibration
papers.en: A controlled calibration study using constructed probabilities. Interpretations of latent uncertainty remain hypotheses.
papers.zh: 使用构造概率进行受控校准测试；对潜在不确定性的解释仍属研究假说。

papers.title: Beyond Calibration: Do Typed Decisions Obey the Probability Axioms?
papers.en: Tests coherence between logically related probabilities, separately from accuracy and calibration.
papers.zh: 检验逻辑相关命题的概率一致性，与准确率和校准分别考察。

papers.title: Typed Decision Models: An Early Evidence Audit and Evaluation Checklist
papers.en: An evidence audit and a checklist for evaluating typed decision models.
papers.zh: 围绕类型化决策模型的证据审查与评估清单。

papers.title: JevAdvBench
papers.en: A black-box adversarial benchmark. A changed decision is not necessarily an incorrect decision.
papers.zh: 黑盒对抗评测基准。决策发生变化，并不必然代表决策错误。

papers.title: LAVOIR: Teaching a Single-Pass Decision Encoder When and What to Ask with Amortized Value of Information
papers.en: Estimates whether asking for missing information would improve a typed decision.
papers.zh: 估计追问缺失信息是否有助于改进类型化决策。

papers.title: From Text Decisions to Pixels
papers.en: A Jev-style visual-choice study separating adaptation gains, candidate-readout validity, and calibration limits.
papers.zh: Jev 风格视觉选择模型研究，区分适配收益、候选读出有效性与校准局限。

papers.title: Jev-Mem: System-One-Controlled Agentic Memory
papers.en: Studies Jev as a controller for agent memory. Reported outcomes concern the complete memory workflow.
papers.zh: 研究以 Jev 控制 agent 记忆；报告结果衡量完整记忆工作流。

papers.title: this-that-model-1.0
papers.en: An open typed-decision model using hidden-state readout. The abstract reports a small external comparison.
papers.zh: 采用隐藏状态读出的开放类型化决策模型。摘要报告了一项小规模外部比较。
